title: Analytics Engineer - Especialista I
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Garante o self-service e acesso à informação através de modelagens de tabelas e métricas coesas, escaláveis e de alto impacto, construindo pipelines robustos, resilientes e de referência técnica para a tribo;
  • Atua como referência na detecção, prevenção e solução de problemas complexos relacionados à disciplina de dados, propondo soluções definitivas e escaláveis que eliminem a recorrência de falhas;
  • Lidera iniciativas estratégicas de dados da tribo, desde o planejamento até a entrega, garantindo alinhamento entre equipes técnicas e de negócio, e promovendo excelência na tomada de decisão baseada em dados;
  • Realiza análises críticas do que está sendo desenvolvido, avaliando impacto, qualidade e reuso por outros times, tanto do ponto de vista de dados quanto de negócio;
  • Propõe e implementa melhorias contínuas em processos de dados, orquestrando stakeholders e fomentando boas práticas que elevem o nível de maturidade analítica da organização;
  • Atua como mentor(a) e referência técnica para analistas de outros níveis, disseminando conhecimento e boas práticas.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência em programação (preferencialmente Python), com aplicação prática em automação, análise avançada e engenharia de dados
  • Domínio em modelagem de dados (conceitual, lógica e física), com experiência comprovada em ambientes complexos e de grande escala;
  • Excelência em SQL, capaz de desenvolver consultas altamente otimizadas e escaláveis;
  • Experiência em ferramentas de visualização de dados (Power BI e Looker Studio preferencialmente), com capacidade de estruturar dashboards estratégicos e narrativas de dados de alto impacto;
  • Noções em ferramentas de orquestração de pipelines (Ex. Airflow ou equivalentes);
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua;
  • Capacidade comprovada de liderar projetos cross-times, influenciar decisões estratégicas e atuar como ponto focal técnico em fóruns executivos e de negócio.

title: Desenvolvedor Java Pleno
description:
Sua próxima oportunidade está a caminho!


A VILT é uma empresa de TI, onde valorizamos nosso pessoal, promovemos o trabalho em equipe e, é claro, o bom humor.


Acreditamos que a diversidade e a inclusão fortalecem o nosso time. Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, e profissionais com deficiência (PCDs) são incentivados a se candidatar.

Dê uma olhada nesta oportunidade de emprego e veja se você é o próximo VILTian! (se você conhece alguém, não se esqueça de recomendá-lo)


Buscamos um Desenvolvedor Java Pleno para atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções backend orientadas a microsserviços, com forte foco em APIs REST, regras de negócio e integrações entre sistemas. Essa pessoa terá participação ativa na evolução da arquitetura, qualidade do código e performance das aplicações, atuando em um ambiente ágil, colaborativo e com desafios técnicos constantes.


O que você irá fazer:

  • Desenvolver, evoluir e manter serviços backend utilizando Java
  • Criar e manter APIs REST escaláveis, seguras e performáticas
  • Implementar regras de negócio e integrações entre sistemas
  • Escrever código limpo, testável e de fácil manutenção
  • Desenvolver e manter testes unitários e de integração
  • Apoiar na análise de requisitos técnicos e funcionais
  • Identificar e corrigir falhas, bugs e gargalos de performance
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de Frontend, QA e Produto
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis (planning, dailies, reviews e retros)
  • Contribuir para melhorias contínuas de arquitetura, padrões e boas práticas


O que esperamos de você:

  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência como Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Java (nível Pleno)
  • Conhecimento sólido em Java e Spring Boot
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de APIs REST
  • Conhecimento em JPA/Hibernate ou frameworks ORM similares
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL ou Oracle)
  • Familiaridade com Git e versionamento de código
  • Conhecimento em testes unitários (JUnit, Mockito)
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban)
  • Noções de CI/CD e pipelines de build e deploy


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com microservices
  • Conhecimento em mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
  • Experiência com bancos NoSQL
  • Vivência com cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)
  • Conhecimento em Docker e Kubernetes
  • Experiência com práticas de Clean Code e SOLID


Informações adicionais:

  • Modelo de contrato CLT.

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:
Requirements:


  • Fluent English communication, written and spoken.
  • BSc/MSc in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of frontend engineering experience on high-availability, scalable systems.
  • Strong fundamentals in JavaScript (Vanilla JS, OOP, clean code, design patterns) and TypeScript (or proven ability to introduce TS incrementally in legacy codebases).
  • Deep React experience using modern state/data patterns (Redux Toolkit, React Query/SWR, Zustand, Context), with the ability to work within existing Redux/Redux-Saga setups.
  • Excellent HTML5/CSS3 skills (Flexbox, Grid), responsive/mobile-first design, and CSS preprocessors (SASS/LESS).
  • Solid understanding of the JavaScript ecosystem (Node.js, Babel) and modern build tooling (Vite/Webpack; npm/yarn/pnpm).
  • Strong testing discipline with Jest, React Testing Library, and Playwright or Cypress; understands TDD principles.
  • Proven experience with performance profiling and optimization (bundle size, rendering, Web Vitals, memory leaks).
  • Strong experience consuming REST APIs and collaborating with backend teams.
  • Comfortable with Git and modern delivery workflows (PRs, code reviews, CI/CD).
  • Hands-on experience using agentic AI coding systems for multi-step engineering tasks.

title: Backend Developer - Node.js
description:
Job Description


We are looking for a Back-end Developer to work on the development and evolution of back-end applications using Node.js and NestJS. The professional will be responsible for building scalable solutions, maintaining engineering best practices, contributing to technical decisions, and collaborating with cross-functional teams in a dynamic and agile environment.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain back-end applications using Node.js and NestJS .
  • Ensure clean, scalable, and well-documented code.


Data Management

  • Implement and manage relational databases (PostgreSQL ) and non-relational databases (MongoDB ).
  • Optimize queries and ensure data integrity.


Version Control

  • Use Git for version control, maintaining code history and integrity.
  • Collaborate through pull requests and code reviews.


Agile Methodologies

  • Actively participate in sprints , plannings, and other agile ceremonies.
  • Adapt quickly to changing requirements and priorities.


Quality & Automation

  • Write automated tests to guarantee quality and stability.
  • Use CI/CD tools to support continuous integration and delivery.


Communication & Teamwork

  • Collaborate with multifunctional teams (product, design, QA, front‑end).
  • Communicate requirements and delivery status clearly.


Nice-to-Have Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable microservices and RESTful APIs .
  • Configure and manage containers using Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Deploy and manage applications on cloud providers (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud ).


Requirements


  • Proficiency in Node.js and NestJS .
  • Strong knowledge of relational (PostgreSQL ) and non-relational (MongoDB ) databases.
  • Experience with version control using Git .
  • Familiarity with agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban ).
  • Ability to write clean, scalable, and well-structured code.
  • Experience with automated testing and CI/CD tools.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.


Differential Competencies

  • Experience with microservices architecture .
  • Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Experience with cloud services (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).



OSF Digital is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, where you can bring your whole self to work. Join an inclusive and passionate community of professionals who help bring about digital transformation for businesses around the world. At OSF Digital, we welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, or any other protected category in any of the jurisdictions in which we conduct business.

title: Arquiteto de Infraestrutura (Plataforma Mainframe)
description:
Procuramos Analista de Suporte Mainframe SR que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.


Modalidade de Trabalho: Atuação em formato Presencial em São Paulo ou Brasília, de 23:00 às 07:00 (Segunda/Sexta).


Perfil que Buscamos:

- Pessoa Responsável por gerar e customização do sistema operacional em suporte, desenvolvimento, homologação e produção (MVS/ESA OS/390 e Z/OS).

- Instalação de sistema operacional e softwares de apoio ao Z/OS com o uso de SMP/E e Suporte a produtos de apoio a equipes de produção, desenvolvimento e produção.


Nesta função você irá:

- Coletar e analisar informações para desenvolvimento e alteração de sistemas.

- Planejar e implantar expansões de hardware I/O usando a ferramenta HCD - Hardware Configuration Definition.

- Planejar e implementar novas Lpares no complexo operacional.

- Estudo, planejamento e implementação de software voltado ao gerenciamento de Storage.

- Participação do grupo de estudo e implementação do DFSMSHSM em ambiente de suporte, desenvolvimento e produção.

- Definição de catalogos ICF CATALOG, bem como definição e manutenção de aliases e reorganização de catalogos com e sem a ferramenta TACM.

- Analisar performance do ambiente produtivo e sugerir alterações que possam maximizar e otimizar os recursos dando suporte a equipe de performance utilizando a ferrameta MAINVIEW.

- Implantação de manutenção de CF Coupling Facility e estruturas HMC: Criar e alterar configurações de hardware e profiles de ativação de CPU.


Necessário ter:

- Formação superior completa na área de TI.

- Experiência como Analista de Suporte na plataforma Mainframe.

- Atendimento de incidentes.

- Garantir o SLA contratado, manter a disponibilidade da infraestrutura funcionando 24×7 em todos os sites.

- Atuação e customização de Sistema Operacional zOS 2.2/2.4/3.1.

- Especialista da Plataforma Mainframe.

- Domínio de software básico IBM: z/OS (RACF, WLM, OMVS, JES3, TCPIP, VTAM, DFSMS, DFHSM e SMP/E).

- Domínio do software EOS ENTERPRISE OUTPUT SOLUTION, Gerenciador de Relatórios.

- Domínio do software GFS/AFM, Gerenciador de Fitoteca.

- Domínio do software GFS/BETA zSecurity, administrador de RACF.

- Programação em linguagens: Assembler, REXX e JCL.

- Coleta e monitoramento pelo software BMC Mainview.

- Noções básicas de Bancos de Dados DB2 e IMS/DB.

- Noções básicas de arquitetura de rede TCP/IP.


O que você pode esperar de nós

- Flexibilidade de trabalho, promovendo o equilíbrio entre sua vida pessoal e profissional. Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.


O que oferecemos?

SONDA Academy: uma plataforma de aprendizado que busca maximizar seu desenvolvimento profissional.Trabalho híbrido. Na SONDA sabemos que a flexibilidade é importante para o seu bem-estar, é por isso que contamos com jornadas presenciais e de teletrabalho.SONDA Wellness, um programa que busca apoiá-lo no equilíbrio da sua vida pessoal e profissional, promovendo uma série de iniciativas focadas na sua saúde física, menta e social.E muito mais!


+ Diversidade + Inclusão = Inovação e colaboração.


Na SONDA estamos comprometidos com a diversidade. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, garantindo que os talentos possam trabalhar em um ambiente positivo que os convide a desenvolver sua carreira profissional com igualdade de oportunidades. Sabermos que a diversidade é um elemento fundamental para impulsionar a inovação, é por isso que buscamos candidatos com base em suas qualificações profissionais, independentemente de raça, cor da pele, religião, idade, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade ou deficiência.


Faça parte da nossa equipe.

title: Estágio Direito
description:
Descrição da Empresa  

A Compliance for Business é uma consultoria referência em Governança Corporativa, atuando em áreas como Compliance, LGPD, DPO Externo, Canal de Denúncias, Investigações Corporativas e Treinamentos. Ajudamos empresas a estarem em conformidade com as mais rigorosas leis e regulamentos, garantindo a segurança jurídica e de dados dos nossos clientes. Nossa equipe é composta por profissionais apaixonados por transformar o mundo corporativo e educar nossos clientes sobre melhores práticas de governança, compliance e privacidade.


O que você irá fazer:

  • Organização e acompanhamento de cronogramas de projetos, acompanhando as fases dos projetos em andamento, garantindo que os prazos sejam cumpridos.
  • Análise e revisão de contratos de clientes e parceiros, com foco em conformidade com a LGPD e demais normas de compliance.
  • Auxílio na elaboração de Políticas, termos de uso e outros documentos essenciais para empresas.
  • Apoio nas auditorias, coletando dados e realizando análises jurídicas sobre a adequação de processos.
  • Pesquisa e análise de regulamentações, mantendo-se atualizado sobre as melhores práticas e mudanças legislativas, especialmente relacionadas à LGPD e Compliance.
  • Auxílio no atendimento ao cliente, esclarecendo dúvidas jurídicas e fornecendo suporte técnico em documentos e processos.


Qualificações

  • Cursando Direito (3º ou 4º ano).
  • Habilidade organizacional para acompanhar e manter o controle de cronogramas e prazos dos projetos.
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes, com capacidade de trabalhar em múltiplas tarefas.
  • Boa comunicação escrita e oral, capaz de redigir relatórios e documentos jurídicos claros e objetivos.


Conhecimentos

  • Pacote Office Intermediário (Excel e Word);
  • Familiaridade com software de gestão de tarefas;
  • Conhecimento básico em contratos, regulamentações de privacidade e compliance regulatório será um diferencial.


O que oferecemos:

  • Regime 100% home-office
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento em um campo dinâmico e em crescimento, com muito aprendizado na área de Governança Corporativa. 
  • Mentoria contínua de profissionais da área jurídica e de compliance.
  • Ambiente colaborativo e dinâmico, com participação ativa em projetos desafiadores.
  • Bolsa-auxílio compatível com o mercado, além de benefícios.

title: Senior Application Developer
description:
Senior Application Developer – AI Course Bots

100% Remote | Long-Term Contract | EST Working Hours

About the Role

Our client is seeking an experienced Senior Application Developer to help build next-generation AI-powered course bots using generative AI technologies on AWS Cloud .

This role will play a key part in transforming business education through intelligent, interactive, and scalable learning experiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop enterprise-grade AI course bots with a focus on scalability, performance, extensibility, and system integration.
  • Implement the technical vision of the course bot platform using appropriate AI models, APIs, and AWS cloud services .
  • Collaborate closely with faculty, product managers, and ed-tech experts to translate educational requirements into technical solutions.
  • Build secure, robust, and scalable cloud-native solutions on AWS for bot deployment and operations.
  • Follow best practices in AI-focused software development , including coding standards, code reviews, and testing methodologies.
  • Integrate cutting-edge generative AI technologies to keep the platform at the forefront of educational innovation.
  • Implement data ingestion, storage, and retrieval pipelines to support AI model workflows.
  • Ensure seamless integration with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and other digital platforms.
  • Implement monitoring, logging, and analytics to track bot performance, usage patterns, and learning outcomes.
  • Enforce security, privacy, and compliance standards , including FERPA and educational data protection requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align technical delivery with business goals and user experience.
  • Stay updated on emerging trends in AI, cloud computing, and educational technology and recommend innovative enhancements.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Software Engineering , or related field.
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, primarily with cloud-native applications .
  • Strong experience with serverless architectures, microservices, and event-driven systems .
  • Hands-on experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) , including GraphRAG and contextual retrieval .
  • Experience with generative AI evaluation frameworks .
  • Experience with multi-agent frameworks such as AutoGen, LangGraph , or similar tools.
  • Strong knowledge of AWS services , especially:
  • AI/ML: SageMaker, Bedrock
  • Serverless: Lambda, Step Functions
  • Data: S3, DynamoDB, RDS
  • Strong production-level coding skills in Python and JavaScript / TypeScript .
  • Experience building AI/NLP applications using pre-trained and autoregressive LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere, Google, etc.).
  • Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs and GraphQL services .
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices , including CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and automated testing.
  • Solid understanding of data security, privacy, and compliance in educational environments.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments .

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in educational technology or e-learning platforms .
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Advanced understanding of LLMs and machine learning algorithms .
  • Contributions to open-source projects or academic research .
  • Knowledge of modern front-end frameworks such as React or Vue.js and backend integration.

  • Collaborate closely with faculty, product managers, and ed-tech experts to translate educational requirements into technical solutions.
  • Build secure, robust, and scalable cloud-native solutions on AWS for bot deployment and operations.
  • Follow best practices in AI-focused software development , including coding standards, code reviews, and testing methodologies.
  • Integrate cutting-edge generative AI technologies to keep the platform at the forefront of educational innovation.
  • Implement data ingestion, storage, and retrieval pipelines to support AI model workflows.
  • Ensure seamless integration with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and other digital platforms.
  • Implement monitoring, logging, and analytics to track bot performance, usage patterns, and learning outcomes.
  • Enforce security, privacy, and compliance standards , including FERPA and educational data protection requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align technical delivery with business goals and user experience.
  • Stay updated on emerging trends in AI, cloud computing, and educational technology and recommend innovative enhancements.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Software Engineering , or related field.
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, primarily with cloud-native applications .
  • Strong experience with serverless architectures, microservices, and event-driven systems .
  • Hands-on experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) , including GraphRAG and contextual retrieval .
  • Experience with generative AI evaluation frameworks .
  • Experience with multi-agent frameworks such as AutoGen, LangGraph , or similar tools.
  • Strong knowledge of AWS services , especially:
  • AI/ML: SageMaker, Bedrock
  • Serverless: Lambda, Step Functions
  • Data: S3, DynamoDB, RDS
  • Strong production-level coding skills in Python and JavaScript / TypeScript .
  • Experience building AI/NLP applications using pre-trained and autoregressive LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere, Google, etc.).
  • Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs and GraphQL services .
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices , including CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and automated testing.
  • Solid understanding of data security, privacy, and compliance in educational environments.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments .

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in educational technology or e-learning platforms .
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Advanced understanding of LLMs and machine learning algorithms .
  • Contributions to open-source projects or academic research .
  • Knowledge of modern front-end frameworks such as React or Vue.js and backend integration.

title: VMware Administrator (VSphere)
description:
Our Client is one of the largest TV providers in North America. We are looking for VMWare Administrator to maintain security, performance monitoring, Installing, configuring, securing, managing, and monitoring VMware vSphere ESXi clusters in multiple data centers.


Responsibilities:

  • Installation, configuration, maintenance, tuning and troubleshooting of VMware environment running on vSphere 6.5, 6.7, 7, 8.
  • Installation of ESXi Host and vCenter Server
  • Upgrading ESXi
  • Responsible for ESXI Host Server Health Check and Performance Monitoring
  • Experience working with VCF, vCenter, vSphere, vROPs
  • Upgrade VM Tools and VM Hardware versions
  • Monitor and remediate security compliance results from tool like Nessus/Tenable
  • Perform VMware crash/error analysis, Root Cause Analysis, Coordinate Post Problem Analysis and Trend Analysis
  • Basic Linux administration
  • On-call support


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • Operating System Proficiency, including Linux (primarily RHEL and Rocky)
  • Server Hardware Management
  • Virtualization, especially VMware
  • Network Management, including DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP
  • Security, including best practices, patch management, vulnerability assessments
  • Monitoring and Troubleshooting


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

  • Managing backups
  • Dell Server Hardware
  • PowerShell
  • Python
  • Storage Platforms such as EMC, Netapp, Isilon, etc.
  • Storage Protocols, including iSCSI, Fibre Channel, NFS
  • Storage Virtualization
  • Storage Security, including access controls and encryption data at rest
  • Ansible


Languages:

  • English: C1 Advanced

title: Mobile Software Engineer – React Native (Mid/Senior)
description:
eNor Securities is a fintech focused on financial infrastructure, digital assets, and regulated products , operating at the intersection of traditional finance and the crypto ecosystem.

We work in a highly complex technical and regulatory environment , building products that require robustness, security, scalability, and clear architecture .

Our engineering team works closely with product and business, making technical decisions with real impact on operations and company growth.

About the role

We are looking for a Mobile Software Engineer with a strong focus on React Native to strategically contribute to the evolution of our mobile applications.

Beyond building screens, we seek someone with strong engineering fundamentals , mobile architectural thinking , and the ability to collaborate closely with backend, product, and design.

You will help build scalable, stable, and high-quality mobile applications , designed to support critical financial products and long-term evolution.


Expected profile
  • Mid to Senior level
  • 5+ years of experience in mobile or frontend development
  • Strong understanding of mobile architecture and state management
  • Comfortable discussing technical trade-offs and proposing solutions
  • Hands-on , collaborative, quality-oriented mindset
  • Technical English required for reading, writing, and professional communication


Required skills
  • Solid experience with React Native
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript
  • Experience with modern mobile architectures and component-based design
  • Familiarity with REST and/or GraphQL APIs
  • Ability to write testable, performant, and maintainable mobile code
  • Understanding of the mobile lifecycle (Android and iOS)


Nice to have
  • State management (Redux, Zustand, MobX, or similar)
  • Modern React / React Native patterns (Hooks, Context, performance optimizations)
  • Mobile testing (Jest, React Native Testing Library, Detox, or similar)
  • App publishing and maintenance on App Store and Google Play
  • Native API integrations (native modules, bridges)
  • Mobile CI/CD
  • Familiarity with Expo (and clarity on when to use or not)


Responsibilities
  • Contribute to the architectural evolution of mobile applications
  • Implement features aligned with product and design
  • Propose improvements in performance, stability, and user experience
  • Ensure scalable, testable, and sustainable mobile code
  • Work closely with backend, product, and design teams
  • Support continuous improvement of mobile practices and standards


Differentials
  • Experience in fintech, crypto, or financial products
  • Background in large-scale or complex mobile applications
  • Knowledge of mobile performance, UX, and security best practices
  • Senior engineer mindset with a systemic and product-oriented view


If you enjoy real technical challenges and want to build impactful financial infrastructure, come join eNor Securities.

title: Cloud Platform Developer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

We seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application. Your role will involve to communicate technical concepts clearly, facilitate discussions, collaborate with stakeholders, provide project updates and mentor team members.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Develop high performance cloud and container technologies mostly leveraging Python as the main programming language;
  • Develop and deliver high quality solutions and code;
  • Develop unit tests, improving the SDLC;
  • Investigate and resolve issues reported during testing and customer integration;
  • Actively participate in all aspects of an agile software development process;
  • Work as part of a team focused on containerization, virtualization and fault tolerant/carrier grade development;
  • Contribute to a highly available orchestration platform used to deploy private cloud platform aimed to be at the core of 5G and distributed Edge deployments worldwide.


Essential Skills

  • Solid backend developer (preferably but not restricted to Python), knowledgeable in Linux Essentials:
  • Medium knowledge in concepts of hardware, processes, programs and the components of the Linux Operating System;
  • How to work on the command line and with files;
  • How to create and restore compressed backups and archives;
  • System security: users/groups and file permissions for public and private directories;
  • How to create and run simple scripts;
  • Interested in working on development and troubleshooting of a highly distributed orchestration platform supporting multiple vendors;
  • Strong computer networking knowledge and transport (TCP/UDP/etc.) layers;
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts;
  • Experience collaborating effectively across remote teams and time zones, and collaborating with Senior Technical Leaders;
  • Experience with GIT, Jira, Gitlab and code review tools;
  • Experience with container technologies (e.g., Docker, Linux Containers, etc.);
  • Experience with Kubernetes Cluster Administration (design infrastructure that involves one or more Kubernetes clusters, configure, control, and monitor Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with Docker;
  • Experience with Helm.


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Kubernetes App Development (design and development of applications that run in Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with PostgreSQL as a developer;
  • Experience with RabbitMQ as a developer.

title: Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

“Estamos buscando um Engenheiro Sênior de Automação de Mainframe experiente para liderar a migração e otimização de soluções de automação em mainframe. Esta função tem como foco a transição do CA OPS/MVS para o IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e do CA Automation Point para o IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM) .

O candidato ideal terá um papel crítico para garantir a eficiência operacional, a disponibilidade dos sistemas e processos de automação contínuos em um ambiente z/OS complexo.

Você irá colaborar de perto com a equipe de Automação para implementar soluções de automação baseadas em políticas, reduzir a sobrecarga administrativa e aumentar a capacidade de resposta dos sistemas. Esta posição não impacta o desenvolvimento de aplicações, mas influencia significativamente as estratégias e operações de automação.”


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar projetos de migração de CA OPS/MVS para IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e de CA Automation Point para IBM SAIOM.
  • Configurar e implementar soluções IBM Systems Automation, incluindo automação baseada em políticas para ambientes z/OS.
  • Desenvolver e manter regras de automação, execs REXX e configurações do System Automation Policy Database (PDB) .
  • Prestar suporte na instalação e configuração de produtos de automação da IBM.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de operações para otimizar processos de inicialização, desligamento e recuperação dos sistemas.
  • Garantir alta disponibilidade e eficiência dos sistemas críticos por meio de estratégias proativas de automação.
  • Documentar processos, configurações e etapas de migração, garantindo comunicação clara com as partes interessadas.
  • Identificar e resolver problemas relacionados à automação em ambientes de produção.


Quais são as habilidades obrigatórias e níveis de proficiência exigidos para esta posição?

  • Experiência em Operações de Mainframe: Mínimo de 5+ anos em ambiente de operações de mainframe, em funções operacionais, de serviços, consultoria ou suporte.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Conhecimento avançado e experiência prática.
  • CA OPS/MVS: Avançado.
  • TSO e ISPF: Proficiência no uso dessas ferramentas para gerenciamento de sistemas.
  • JCL: Fortes habilidades em Job Control Language.
  • Programação REXX: Capacidade de escrever e manter scripts REXX.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Conhecimento prático obrigatório.
  • Experiência em Migração: Histórico comprovado em projetos de migração de automação em z/OS.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experiência na implementação e utilização deste produto.
  • Scripting REXX: Avançado.


Quais são as habilidades opcionais e níveis de proficiência desejáveis para esta posição?

  • Conhecimento de outros softwares IBM Z, incluindo operação, configuração e automação de sistemas.
  • Familiaridade com processos de inicialização e desligamento do sistema z/OS.
  • Experiência com SMP/E para instalação e manutenção de software.
  • Entendimento de produtos de automação concorrentes no ecossistema de mainframe.
  • Especialização em configurações de sistemas totalmente automatizados em IBM Z.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Company Description

At Company 86, we specialize in cybersecurity, digital transformation, and advanced AI implementation to deliver measurable and secure results for our clients. With decades of real-world experience, we focus on practical and future-ready outcomes through strategy, design, and delivery. Our mission is to ensure successful, transformative solutions that meet the evolving needs of businesses. We are committed to innovation and delivering cutting-edge expertise through our core principles: Cyber, Transformation, and AI.


Role Description

I’m working with a small, high- trust team that’s hiring 2 Staff / Senior Staff Software Engineer  — someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes real ownership, and prefers defining problems rather than waiting for tickets. This is not  a “tasks + Jira board” role. You’d be shaping architecture, shipping meaningful systems, and using agentic coding tools (Cursor / Claude Code, etc.) as true force multipliers — not crutches.

You’d be a great fit if you:

 • Own outcomes end-to-end — not just code

 • Work comfortably across Python + TypeScript / React

 • Have experience integrating LLM APIs  (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.)

 • Enjoy making smart trade-offs with imperfect info

 • Prefer small, high-impact teams over large, process-heavy environments

It’s ideal for someone who notices broken assumptions early, treats ambiguity as raw material, and raises the bar through example rather than process.

title: Analista de Infraestrutura – Observabilidade
description:
** Veja no final como se candidatar **


Estamos em busca de um Profissional de Monitoramento de Infraestrutura para uma posição remota em tempo integral.


O candidato selecionado desempenhará um papel essencial na garantia da saúde, estabilidade e desempenho de nossa infraestrutura.


As responsabilidades incluem:

  • Monitorar o desempenho de sistemas e redes utilizando ferramentas modernas de observabilidade
  • Analisar métricas e logs para detectar e resolver problemas de forma proativa
  • Comunicar resultados e incidentes de maneira eficaz com equipes técnicas e clientes
  • Realizar pesquisas e propor melhorias em estratégias de monitoramento e automação
  • Fornecer suporte técnico e atendimento de alta qualidade aos clientes


Qualificações:

  • Mínimo de 1 ano de experiência recente em monitoramento de infraestrutura e gerenciamento de rede
  • Forte experiência prática com ferramentas como Zabbix, Prometheus, Grafana, InfluxDB, NetBox ou soluções semelhantes.
  • Sólida compreensão de conceitos de rede (sub-redes IP, BGP, modelo OSI, TCP/UDP)
  • Conhecimento avançado em sistemas operacionais Linux e Windows
  • Experiência com scripts (Python, Perl ou Bash) para automação e integração de ferramentas
  • Excelentes habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas
  • Boas habilidades de comunicação e atendimento ao cliente
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e colaborativa em equipe distribuída
  • Certificações ou formação em Tecnologia da Informação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas relacionadas serão consideradas um diferencial


Observações Importantes:

  • Regime de contratação PJ .
  • Atuação em tempo integral com foco exclusivo. (*Não permitida jornada dupla*)
  • Trabalho remoto  com flexibilidade de horário.


Como se candidatar

  • Envie por email com o assunto \"Analista de Infraestrutura \" o seu currículo e informe-nos sua pretensão e por que você se encaixa nesta vaga. **Você não deve aplicar à vaga no LinkedIn**

title: Pizzaiolo
description:
Vaga: Pizzaiolo

Local: Pizzaria Cabanas – Campo Grande, MS

Descrição da função:

Responsável pelo preparo das massas, montagem e finalização das pizzas conforme os padrões da casa. Deve garantir a qualidade, apresentação e agilidade no preparo dos pedidos, respeitando normas de higiene e segurança alimentar.

Habilidades necessárias:

  • Experiência com forno industrial.
  • Conhecimento em massas artesanais e montagem de pizzas.
  • Organização e limpeza do ambiente de trabalho.
  • Agilidade, atenção aos detalhes e trabalho em equipe.

Diferenciais:

  • Criatividade para novas receitas e sabores.
  • Experiência anterior em pizzarias tradicionais ou delivery.
  • Curso na área de gastronomia ou panificação.

title: Cientista de dados
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

Responsabilidades

Liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento de modelos estatísticos e preditivos avançados;

Atuar em desafios complexos de análise preditiva e modelagem customizada;

Propor melhorias, inovações e novas abordagens de modelagem;

Avaliar, validar e aprimorar modelos existentes;

Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time;

Garantir aderência técnica e alinhamento dos modelos às necessidades de negócio e ao ciclo de crédito.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

Ensino superior completo em Estatística, Matemática, Engenharias, Física ou áreas correlatas;

Conhecimento avançado em estatística, machine learning e modelagem preditiva;

Ampla experiência em manipulação e análise de dados;

Forte domínio de programação (Python e/ou R);

Conhecimento sólido do ciclo de crédito;

Capacidade de atuar com autonomia técnica e tomada de decisão.


Formato de trabalho: Home office


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Node Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


The Node Developer position requires a problem solver who combines experience, knowledge, and independence to tackle complex tasks. This role involves architecting backend systems, implementing features at a rapid pace, and contributing to building a world-class engineering team while maintaining high standards of code quality and innovation.


Key responsibilities:


- Architecting backend systems using best practices.

- Implementing and iterating features strategically.

- Working collaboratively and efficiently across functional teams in a fast-paced early-stage startup environment.

- Designing, extending, and implementing APIs.

- Maintaining high engineering quality standards through code reviews, unit tests, and analytics.

- Improving engineering productivity through automation and tool development.

- Defining engineering processes for product launches and releases.

- Helping grow the engineering team by conducting technical interviews.


Requirements:


- Node.js Experience: 5+ years of experience in Node development.

- Database Skills: Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases.

- Architecture Knowledge: Experience with microservices and cloud platforms.

- Algorithm Proficiency: Advanced algorithm knowledge.

- Infrastructure Understanding: IT infrastructure knowledge.

- Agile Methodology: Intermediate agile methodologies management.

- Best Practices: Strong understanding of SOLID principles, clean code, and scalable solutions.

- Design Patterns: Knowledge of software design patterns.

- Application Development: Experience developing entire applications from scratch.

- Testing & Deployment: Experience in automated tests and CI/CD pipelines.

- Version Control: Strong experience with version control systems.

- Language Skills: Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Java Fullstack Developer (Angular)
description:
About You

You are a software engineer who enjoys building robust, scalable, and well-structured applications. You’re motivated by clean architecture, modern technologies, and meaningful collaboration across backend and frontend layers. You’re looking for a place where you can grow professionally, influence technical decisions, and contribute to high-impact products used by real customers.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of professional experience developing backend solutions using Java (21+) and Spring Boot.
  • Strong experience building and maintaining monolithic backend applications following clean architecture principles.
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and in-memory data stores such as Redis.
  • Proven experience working with AWS services, including S3, ECS, CloudWatch, and Bedrock.
  • Experience using MyBatis as an ORM and Liquibase for database versioning and migrations.
  • 2+ years of professional experience with Angular (v19 or similar), with strong usage of RxJS and Observables.
  • Familiarity with frontend monolith architectures and modern client-side frameworks.
  • Advanced knowledge of Git and version control best practices.
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Participate in collaborative concept definition, architectural refinement, and software design across backend and frontend layers.
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable monolithic applications using Java 21 and Spring Boot.
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and integrate them with Angular frontend applications using RxJS and Observables.
  • Implement and manage data persistence using PostgreSQL, MyBatis, Liquibase, and Redis.
  • Work with AWS infrastructure services (S3, ECS, CloudWatch, Bedrock) to support application deployment, monitoring, and observability.
  • Follow Agile practices, working independently while collaborating closely with a cross-functional team.
  • Maintain high-quality technical documentation throughout the SDLC.


Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: ARQUITETO DE APLICAÇÂO .NET
description:
Estamos buscando um talento para a posição de ARQUITETO DE APLICAÇÂO .NET


A G4F é uma empresa com uma trajetória sólida de 15 anos, dedicada a conectar pessoas, ideias e tecnologia para oferecer soluções inovadoras. Somos mais de 8.000 #greaters atuando em todo o Brasil.


Requisitos:

  • Graduação em curso de nível superior na área de Tecnologia da Informação;
  • Experiência exercendo atividades como arquiteto de aplicações.NET.


Desejável:

  • Certificação CSD - Certified Scrum Developer.
  • Certificações:

• MCSA: Microsoft Certified Solutions Associate: Web Applications;

• MCSD: Microsoft Certified Solutions Developer: App Builder;

• Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert;

• Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate.

  • Experiência na área de Sistema Operacional Windows Server:

• configuração do Internet Information Server;

• configuração, instalação e publicação de aplicações e assemblies .NET;

• conceitos de versionamento de assemblies e binding policies em WCF (Windows Communication Foundation);

• implementação e configuração de SSL (Secure Sockets Layer);

• balanceamento de carga baseado em Transfer Protocol);

• conceitos de SOA (Service Oriented Architecture);

• conhecimento de serviços de enfileiramento de mensagens (MSMQ / IBM MQ Series);

• conhecimentos de COM e COM+;

• conhecimentos de MTS;

• conceitos de Windows Internals;

• conceitos de Active Directory;

• conceitos de Windows API.

  • Experiência na área de Desenvolvimento Linguagem C# .Net:

• conceitos de interoperabilidade entre plataforma .NET (código gerenciado / managed) e COM+ (código não gerenciado / unmanaged);

• conceitos e técnicas de segurança em .NET (Autenticação, autorização e comunicação segura);

• criação de WebServices em WCF para IIS/WAS;

• conceitos de XML e XML Schema;

• configuração e uso do framework de persistência NHibernate;

• conceitos e aplicações de padrões de projeto (design patterns);

• conhecimento de XML e XML Schema;

• conceitos e técnicas de segurança em aplicações COM+;

• desenvolvimento de aplicações WIN32 e WIN64;

• desenvolvimento de aplicações WEB;

• desenvolvimento de aplicações de arquitetura multicamadas;

• conhecimentos de desenvolvimento de aplicações de arquitetura cliente / servidor.

  • Experiência na área de Banco de Dados:

• conhecimento de bancos de dados e configuração (ODBC);

• conhecimentos em bancos de dados Microsoft SQL Server e IBM DB2;

• conceitos de ADO.Experiência na área de Cloud (Azure):

• design de arquitetura para Cloud (Azure);

• desenvolvimento de soluções .NET para Azure.

  • Conhecimento em modelagem e documentação de API’s RESTful.Conhecimento de padrões abertos de autenticação e autorização de usuários, frameworks de desenvolvimento de aplicações móveis.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Senior Data Scientist who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

SAFe We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist with extensive experience in Python, Machine Learning, and advanced knowledge of AWS components to lead data analysis projects and develop scalable solutions. Technologies such as Deep Learning and GenAI will be considered advantages.

Experience with Deep Learning (TensorFlow, PyTorch). Knowledge in GenAI (LLMs, Prompt Engineering, APIs such as OpenAI, HuggingFace). Experience with multimodal models.

Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, or related fields.

Experience:

Advanced programming in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn).

Development and implementation of Machine Learning models at scale.

Solid experience with AWS components (S3, Lambda, SageMaker, EC2, IAM).

Experience in technical leadership or team mentoring.

Additional skills:

Handling large volumes of data.

Knowledge of SQL and relational/non-relational databases.

Best practices in MLOps and CI/CD for models.

Lead the design, development, and implementation of Machine Learning models for complex applications.

Build robust and scalable data pipelines, ensuring quality and performance.

Define architecture and integrate solutions with AWS services (S3, Lambda, SageMaker, EC2, IAM).

Act as a technical reference, guiding teams and ensuring best practices.

Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business needs into data-driven solutions.

Document processes and promote standards for versioning, testing, and deployment.

Python, Machine Learning; components AWS

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

description:
Mandatory Skills Description:


  • Operating System Proficiency, including Linux (primarily RHEL and Rocky)
  • Server Hardware Management
  • Virtualization, especially VMware
  • Network Management, including DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP
  • Security, including best practices, patch management, vulnerability assessments
  • Monitoring and Troubleshooting



Project Description:


  • Our Client is one of the largest TV providers in North America. We are looking for VMWare Administrator to maintain security, performance monitoring, Installing, configuring, securing, managing, and monitoring VMware vSphere ESXi clusters in multiple data centers.


Responsibilities:


  • Installation, configuration, maintenance, tuning and troubleshooting of VMware environment running on vSphere 6.5, 6.7, 7, 8.
  • Installation of ESXi Host and vCenter Server
  • Upgrading ESXi
  • Responsible for ESXI Host Server Health Check and Performance Monitoring
  • Experience working with VCF, vCenter, vSphere, vROPs
  • Upgrade VM Tools and VM Hardware versions
  • Monitor and remediate security compliance results from tool like Nessus/Tenable
  • Perform VMware crash/error analysis, Root Cause Analysis, Coordinate Post Problem Analysis and Trend Analysis
  • Basic Linux administration
  • On-call support

title: Analista de SRE
description:
Somos protagonistas na transformação digital dos meios de pagamento, somos a HST!

Desvendamos os desafios mais complexos e desde a nossa fundação temos a missão de tornar as transações eletrônicas mais seguras.


Estamos presentes em +20 Países e, dentre os nossos Clientes, estão os 8 Bancos mais importantes do Brasil e os 20 da América Latina!


São +80.000 terminais de autoatendimento; +1.000.000 autenticações de transações de compras eletrônicas ao mês; +800.000 cartões bancários com chip disponibilizados ao mês em lojas e agências bancárias; e até em 2024, foram +100 bancos utilizando nossos sistemas de emissor que permitem a tokenização de cartões COF (Card on File) e eCommerce. Isso é só uma parte dos nossos resultados, mas também é só começo!


Nos bastidores de todas as nossas conquistas está o nosso Time, que conta com +200 Pessoas envolvidas no desenvolvimento das nossas soluções. Pessoas questionadoras, curiosas, criativas, proativas, colaborativas e abertas a novas experiências!

Para saber mais sobre a HST e sobre as nossas oportunidades, acesse:


Buscamos uma pessoa Analista de SRE (Pleno) para se unir ao nosso Time de Infrastructure para:

  • Atuação no monitoramento do desempenho das ferramentas de nosso ambiente de produção, tanto voltado a Infraestrutura quanto na Aplicação SAAS;
  • Configuração e Gestão da Plataforma Zabbix;
  • Auxílio no desenvolvimento de Dashboards Avançados utilizando Grafana;
  • Gerenciamento dos alertas via Opsgenie.


Acreditamos ser importante que você já tenha passado por algumas experiências e que também tenha os seguintes conhecimentos:

  • Ensino Superior completo em cursos relacionados a TI;
  • Experiencia com Linux (Distribuição Ubuntu);
  • Experiencia com Software de Monitoramento Zabbix / Datadog;
  • Experiencia com Redes e Protocolos de Segurança;
  • Experiencia em ambientes de Cloud Privada;
  • Inglês Avançado.


Será um grande diferencial se:

  • Desenvolvimento de Scripts;
  • Linguagem de programação Python;
  • Automatização utilizando Ansible;
  • Conhecimento com produtos, ou com os conceitos relacionados com meios de pagamento.


O que oferecemos?

A HST é uma empresa certificada GPTW! Oferecemos a oportunidade de crescimento em um ambiente de desafios em que a contrapartida de cada Pessoa equivale ao tamanho da sua vontade de crescer !

  • Contratação em regime CLT;
  • Atuação 100% Remota;
  • Horário flexível;
  • Oportunidade de crescimento, através do contínuo desenvolvimento, tanto técnico quanto pessoal;
  • Temos programas de desenvolvimento destinado às novas lideranças;
  • 10% das horas mensais, podem ser dedicadas para aprender algo novo;
  • Day-Off no mês do aniversário;
  • Ajuda de Custo Home Office;
  • Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Ampliadas;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • WellHub (antiga Gympass);
  • Convênio médico;
  • Convênio odontológico;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição;
  • Vale Transporte ou estacionamento;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Seguro de Vida.


Prezamos por um bom ambiente de trabalho que contribua para as pessoas evoluírem e se sentirem acolhidas, livres, autênticas e à vontade para demonstrarem suas habilidades! Apoiamos a diversidade e não temos espaço para qualquer tipo de discriminação!

title: Frontend Developer
description:
Ascendion is a full-service digital engineering solutions company. We make and manage software platforms and products that power growth and deliver captivating experiences to consumers and employees. Our engineering, cloud, data, experience design, and talent solution capabilities accelerate transformation and impact for enterprise clients. Headquartered in New Jersey, our workforce of 6,000+ Ascenders delivers solutions from around the globe. Ascendion is built differently to engineer the next.

Ascendion | Engineering to elevate life

We have a culture built on opportunity, inclusion, and a spirit of partnership. Come, change the world with us:

  • Build the coolest tech for world’s leading brands
  • Solve complex problems – and learn new skills
  • Experience the power of transforming digital engineering for Fortune 500 clients
  • Master your craft with leading training programs and hands-on experience

Experience a community of change makers!

Join a culture of high-performing innovators with endless ideas and a passion for tech. Our culture is the fabric of our company, and it is what makes us unique and diverse. The way we share ideas, learning, experiences, successes, and joy allows everyone to be their best at Ascendion.

About the Role:


  • Role: Front End Engineer
  • Location: Remote (Brazil)
  • Employment Type: Contract


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize web interfaces using ReactJS
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality features
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices in UI development
  • Ensure responsive design and seamless performance across devices
  • Troubleshoot and resolve UI issues throughout development lifecycle

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience with ReactJS :
  • Mid-Level: 3–4 years of hands-on ReactJS experience
  • Senior: 5+ years of hands-on ReactJS experience
  • Proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+) , HTML5, CSS3, and related front-end tools
  • Experience with state management (Redux, Context API, etc.)
  • Knowledge of version control (Git) and agile development methodologies
  • Must currently be actively working with ReactJS technologies

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Liferay DXP
description:
Buscamos um(a) profissional para atuar como parceiro independente da Brivia.


Somos um ecossistema especializado na transformação de marcas, ajudando nossos clientes a superar desafios em transformação digital, tecnologia e marketing. Para isso, buscamos constantemente expandir nossas capacidades, contando com os melhores especialistas em diversas áreas.


O Brivia_Group quer contar com o seu talento para fortalecer ainda mais nosso ecossistema de transformação digital!


Tem interesse em participar de grandes projetos e ser recompensado no nível das suas competências e entregas? Então, vem com a gente!


Sobre a vaga:


Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor(a) com experiência robusta em desenvolvimento e customização de soluções baseadas na plataforma Liferay DXP . Candidato(a) ideal possui certificação oficial Liferay, forte domínio das tecnologias front-end e back-end, e capacidade para atuar em todas as etapas do ciclo de desenvolvimento.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver, customizar e evoluir portlets, módulos e APIs na plataforma Liferay DXP.
  • Atuar com tecnologias front-end (React, Angular, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript) e back-end (Java, Spring Framework).
  • Garantir qualidade do código, seguindo padrões, melhores práticas e princípios SOLID.
  • Participar de toda a cadeia de desenvolvimento: levantamento de requisitos, análise, codificação, testes, deploy e manutenção.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares (UX/UI, QA, Arquitetura, DevOps) para entregar soluções integradas.
  • Realizar revisões de código, mentoring e transferência de conhecimento para times menos experientes.
  • Auxiliar na definição de arquitetura técnica e soluções para desafios complexos da plataforma.
  • Contribuir para a automação de processos de build, integração contínua e deploy (CI/CD).
  • Documentar código, APIs e soluções técnicas implementadas.


Requisitos técnicos e experiência

  • Certificação BEWL (Building Enterprise Websites with Liferay) concluída (base técnica para desenvolvedores Liferay), atualizada para Liferay DXP 7.4 ULTIMO ANO .
  • Conhecimento/experiência prática em Liferay DXP 7.4 (últimas releases), alinhado ao conteúdo do BEWL .
  • Profundo conhecimento da arquitetura Liferay DXP, incluindo OSGi, portlets MVC, hooks, extensões e APIs.
  • Experiência sólida em Java, Spring Framework, JSP e frameworks front-end modernos (React, Angular).
  • Domínio de tecnologias web: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL.
  • Experiência com integração via RESTful APIs e SOAP.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas e práticas DevOps, CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Docker).
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Boa capacidade analítica, atenção a detalhes e foco em qualidade.Competências comportamentais
  • Proatividade e autonomia para resolver problemas técnicos complexos.
  • Comunicação clara e eficaz, facilitando o trabalho em equipe.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão e em ambientes dinâmicos.
  • Espírito colaborativo e foco em resultados.
  • Desejo constante de aprendizado e atualização tecnológica.


Por que ser um parceiro do ecossistema Brivia_Group?


  • Seja Nômade : Atue pontualmente de onde e quando quiser de acordo com cada uma das demandas individualmente


  • Desenvolvimento Contínuo : Você poderá acessar treinamentos exclusivos no Brivia Academy e estar sempre atualizado


  • Multidisciplinaridade : Trabalhe com profissionais competentes e experientes de vários lugares do mundo


  • Ganhos Escaláveis : Quanto mais projetos concluir, maior será sua remuneração


  • Grandes Marcas : Seja parte de entregas para as maiores marcas brasileiras e internacionais.


Junte-se a um ecossistema dinâmico e faça parte da revolução do mercado!

title: Data Management Analyst
description:
About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


Job Summary

We are looking for Data Management Coordinator professionals to join our team. This role is fully remote in Brazil (CLT) and offers an opportunity to work in a dynamic environment supporting critical data processes.


We are seeking Data Management Coordinator professionals to join our team in fully remote positions based in Brazil (CLT). This role supports critical data processes and requires strong attention to detail, accuracy, and collaboration across multiple teams.


While all coordinators will work within MDM processes, there are two distinct specializations :

  • Credit & Contract Administration – Responsible for managing the contract lifecycle, reviewing documentation for accuracy, performing credit checks, and ensuring proper data entry across multiple platforms.
  • Location & Administrative Maintenance – Focused on maintaining location data integrity, including new setups, updates, closures, and supporting special projects related to merchant and location administration.


Both specializations play a key role in supporting operational excellence and require the ability to meet deadlines while delivering high-quality results.


Responsibilities

  • Process assignments within standard timelines (2 business days)
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of data in MDM systems
  • Collaborate with Sales, Account Management, and Finance teams
  • Track and report data metrics for compliance and performance


Credit & Contract Administration:

  • Review incoming contract documentation for discrepancies
  • Perform credit checks in accordance with company policy
  • Enter approved contracts into multiple systems
  • Maintain merchant documentation and follow up on pending agreements


Location & Administrative Maintenance:

  • Set up new locations and update existing records in MDM
  • Manage location name changes, moves, closures, and inactivations
  • Support special projects assigned by the Data Administration Team


Requirements

  • College degree preferred (not required)
  • Professional English communication skills
  • Strong Excel skills (VLOOKUP and report comparison functions) for MDM profile
  • Administrative experience and ORACLE knowledge for contract profile
  • Ability to learn quickly and work well in a team
  • Credit review experience is a plus


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills
  • Ability to manage repetitive tasks efficiently
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced environments
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills


Benefits

Monthly internet/mobile allowance

️ Meal and food vouchers

Annual bonus

Health and dental plan

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview:

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will play a key role in the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions to support the company's mission and goals. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Platform Development: Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel, ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Database Development: Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes
  • API Development and Integration: Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.
  • Security Compliance: Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA, by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities:

  • Mentor junior developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in the agile development process, contributing to sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.
  • Collaborate with the design team to refine the platform's user interface and experience, implementing responsive and intuitive front-end functionalities using modern JavaScript frameworks.


Competencies/Requirements:

  • Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL. Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git.
  • Experience: At least 5 years of experience in backend development, with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Attention to Detail: A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Product Owner
description:
About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


About This Opportunity

As a Product Owner, you will work closely with both our Business Intelligence and Reporting Teams. In this position you will be accountable to manage data and reporting requirements to fulfill stakeholder or customer requests. You will also lead the roadmap and requirements analysis primarily for our financial systems.


The ideal candidate will have experience with Scrum/ Agile processes, Accounting/Financial Systems, SSRS, PowerBI, and Tableau. Knowledge of ETL and Oracle/Oracle EBS is a plus.


Professional English Language skills are required.


Position is CLT and fully remote (must reside in Brazil). Benefits include health and dental insurance, meal and restaurant vouchers, fixed monthly stipend for Internet and mobile expenses, InComm hardware/software, and annual bonuses!



Responsibilities

  • Work directly with Finance & Accounting leadership and BI teams on product backlog and coordinate with various technology teams across InComm to implement new solutions.
  • Build, manage and prioritize product backlog based on the overall strategy and business objectives for future product development.
  • Responsible for creating and/or managing following artifacts:

-Road Map

-Development Backlog

-User Stories and Sprint Tasks

-Supporting documents for user stories


  • Monitor and Review ServiceNow (SNOW) requests
  • Create product vision and roadmap which accomplishes the goal of the vision and convey that vision to the scrum team.
  • Ensure user stories are well defined and ready for development to begin.
  • Responsible for optimizing the value of the work done.
  • Accountable for each stage of the development process and the final product.
  • Ensure close collaboration with development team. Be available to address any questions team members have regarding requirements or implementation of a product feature.
  • Responsible for communicating with stakeholders across the board, including product managers, leadership, customers, and the development team to make sure their vision is aligned with business objectives.


Preferred Qualifications/Experience:

  • Experience with reporting and operations within Billing, Accounting, and Sales
  • Experience working in Agile/Technical environments
  • Skilled in and comfortable working alongside technical stakeholders, translating business needs into clear, actionable inputs for development or support teams.
  • Proficient in Agile/Scrum
  • Agile/Scrum Certification
  • General knowledge of ERP, Databases (Oracle & MS SQL) and DataLakesis a plus
  • SRS, PowerBI, and Tableau and knowledge of ETL.


InComm provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or national origin, citizenship, veteran’s status, age, disability status, genetics or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law.

description:
About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


About This Opportunity

As a Product Owner, you will work closely with both our Business Intelligence and Reporting Teams. In this position you will be accountable to manage data and reporting requirements to fulfill stakeholder or customer requests. You will also lead the roadmap and requirements analysis primarily for our financial systems.


The ideal candidate will have experience with Scrum/ Agile processes, Accounting/Financial Systems, SSRS, PowerBI, and Tableau. Knowledge of ETL and Oracle/Oracle EBS is a plus.


Professional English Language skills are required.


Position is CLT and fully remote (must reside in Brazil). Benefits include health and dental insurance, meal and restaurant vouchers, fixed monthly stipend for Internet and mobile expenses, InComm hardware/software, and annual bonuses!



Responsibilities

  • Work directly with Finance & Accounting leadership and BI teams on product backlog and coordinate with various technology teams across InComm to implement new solutions.
  • Build, manage and prioritize product backlog based on the overall strategy and business objectives for future product development.
  • Responsible for creating and/or managing following artifacts:

-Road Map

-Development Backlog

-User Stories and Sprint Tasks

-Supporting documents for user stories


  • Monitor and Review ServiceNow (SNOW) requests
  • Create product vision and roadmap which accomplishes the goal of the vision and convey that vision to the scrum team.
  • Ensure user stories are well defined and ready for development to begin.
  • Responsible for optimizing the value of the work done.
  • Accountable for each stage of the development process and the final product.
  • Ensure close collaboration with development team. Be available to address any questions team members have regarding requirements or implementation of a product feature.
  • Responsible for communicating with stakeholders across the board, including product managers, leadership, customers, and the development team to make sure their vision is aligned with business objectives.


Preferred Qualifications/Experience:

  • Experience with reporting and operations within Billing, Accounting, and Sales
  • Experience working in Agile/Technical environments
  • Skilled in and comfortable working alongside technical stakeholders, translating business needs into clear, actionable inputs for development or support teams.
  • Proficient in Agile/Scrum
  • Agile/Scrum Certification
  • General knowledge of ERP, Databases (Oracle & MS SQL) and DataLakesis a plus
  • SRS, PowerBI, and Tableau and knowledge of ETL.


InComm provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or national origin, citizenship, veteran’s status, age, disability status, genetics or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: Accounting Specialist
description:
Location: Remote (LATAM)

Salary Range: $1,800 – $2,500 USD/month,


Role Overview

We’re looking for a proactive and detail-driven Controller to lead accounting operations across our client base. At our company we serve some of the most exciting names in tech and fintech, and your role will be key to making sure the numbers stay clean, clear, and compliant. If you love QuickBooks, live for clean reconciliations, and thrive in remote environments — let’s talk!


✅ Key responsabilities

Own full-cycle bookkeeping in QuickBooks (AR, AP, reconciliations, billing, etc.).

Ensure accuracy and completeness of financial records.

Collaborate with our Head of Accounting Ops to prepare financial statements (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow).

Maintain compliance with accounting standards and best practices.

Support month-end and year-end closing processes.


Requirements

3+ years of hands-on finance-accounting experience.

Expert in QuickBooks and familiar with other accounting tools.

Solid understanding of accounting principles and workflows.

Sharp attention to detail and strong organizational skills

Excellent communicator and team player.

Comfortable working independently in a fully remote setup.

Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.


Nice to have

CPA certification.

Previous experience in client-facing or startup environments.

Tech-savvy and confident navigating remote collaboration tools.

title: Especialista de Redes
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!


Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Sólida experiência em ambientes de monitoramento e sustentação de tecnologia;
  • Expertise em redes Cisco R&S;
  • Conhecimento em protocolos de monitoramento de rede;
  • Habilidade com ferramentas como Zabbix, Grafana e Ansible;
  • Capacidade de seguir padrões, políticas e procedimentos técnicos;
  • Inglês intermediário, com boa comunicação escrita e verbal;
  • Experiência comprovada em redes Cisco;


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo;
  • Experiencia com Cisco;
  • Desejável: Certificação CCNP;


O que te oferecemos:

Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Auxílio Creche;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência Médica;

title: Operations Analytics
description:
We're looking for a Operations Analytics 100% remote in Brazil


Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-time


About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced Operations Analytics professional to deliver high-impact insights that support our end-to-end operations. In this role, you will work closely with teams across inventory, logistics, retail, and customer service, while partnering with technology and finance stakeholders. You’ll engage with nearly all aspects of a growing business to measure performance, identify opportunities, and drive alignment toward the most impactful operational improvements.

What You’ll Do

  • Analyze, understand, and quantify key operational efficiency metrics.
  • Design, implement, and report on item-level data throughout receiving, authentication, launch, and outbound workflows.
  • Provide daily reporting and product-health measurements to support business decision-making.
  • Communicate insights clearly and effectively to partner teams and leadership.
  • Collaborate with operations analysts to optimize processes and uncover opportunities for growth.


Minimum Requirements:

  • 5+ years of analytics experience.
  • Expert-level proficiency in SQL.
  • 5+ years working with BI tools such as MicroStrategy, Tableau, Looker, etc.
  • Strong ability to translate practical business problems into technical solutions.
  • Proven experience delivering time-sensitive strategic projects involving methodology development, analysis, recommendations, and executive presentation.
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in ambiguous environments.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in eCommerce or logistics industries.
